title: TrustDiscountPolicy
description: Trust Discount policy advertised by a federated exchange via /.well-known/a2a-trust-policy.json and during the peering handshake.

algorithm_id.description: URN identifying the Trust Discount algorithm from the registry.

initial_rho.description: Starting rho value for newly peered exchanges before any cross-exchange activity.

parameters.description: Algorithm-specific parameters. The schema depends on the algorithm_id.

volume_threshold_ate.description: ATE volume threshold at which rho reaches rho_at_threshold.

rho_at_threshold.description: Rho value when volume_threshold_ate is reached.

max_rho.description: Maximum achievable rho value for this peer relationship.

attestation_success_floor.description: Minimum attestation success rate required to maintain non-zero rho.

review_cadence_days.description: How often the Trust Discount parameters are reviewed.
